description:
Change the password for a wallet's encrypted keystore.
Performs an atomic operation: backs up the keystore, re-encrypts with the new password, verifies the round-trip, then cleans up. If anything fails, the original keystore is restored.
If the wallet is currently unlocked, it will be locked after rotation (requires re-unlock with new password).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

newPassword.description: New password (minimum 8 characters) - WARNING: sensitive value

oldPassword.description: Current wallet password - WARNING: sensitive value

walletId.description: Wallet ID to rotate password for (uses active wallet if not specified)

name: wallet_rotate_password
